tasks.check: deno check modules/ && deno lint && deno fmt --check
tasks.web-app:build: deno bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --output=modules/web-app/dist/app.js modules/web-app/src/app.ts && cp modules/web-app/src/app.html modules/web-app/dist/app.html
tasks.chrome-extension:build: deno bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --outdir=modules/chrome-extension/dist modules/chrome-extension/src/background.ts modules/chrome-extension/src/bridge.ts modules/chrome-extension/src/page.ts modules/chrome-extension/src/popup.ts && cp modules/chrome-extension/src/manifest.json modules/chrome-extension/src/popup.html modules/chrome-extension/dist/
tasks.server:build: deno task web-app:build && cd modules/server/typescript && deno task build
tasks.server:build:macos-arm64: deno task web-app:build && cd modules/server/typescript && deno task build:macos-arm64
tasks.server:build:linux-arm64: deno task web-app:build && cd modules/server/typescript && deno task build:linux-arm64
